adjudication.rationale: The new API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` calls `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` (around line ~29) and then does `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` (around lines ~52-55) with no surrounding `try/catch` and no use of `safeParse`. Both `zod.parse` and `JSON.parse` will throw on malformed input (and decrypt may also throw), which in a Next.js API handler will surface as an unhandled exception and typically return a generic 500 response rather than a structured 4xx JSON error. This matches the finding and is directly verifiable from the diff.
